patterns.note: Full-width sections with strong visual separation, often using distinct background colors or full-bleed imagery, creating clear content blocks.
Prominent use of a bold, modern sans-serif for large headings, often in all caps or title case, contrasted with a more standard sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A high-contrast palette of black, dark grey, and white, punctuated by vibrant, energetic accent colors (lime green/yellow, bright blue, red) derived from product imagery and brand elements.

A transforming sticky navigation bar that changes appearance (shrinks, gains background, logo color change) and position on scroll, and a hero section with a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground text.
Large, impactful hero sections featuring full-bleed product photography or video, followed by category browsing sections and curated product displays presented in responsive grids or carousels.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar uses a scroll-triggered transformation, shrinking in height, changing background color, and updating logo color as it transitions from an overlay to a sticky header. This is likely achieved with CSS transitions and JavaScript scroll listeners.
The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect where the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground text, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls.
Product carousels are implemented using a slider library (swiper) to showcase multiple items horizontally within a constrained space, allowing users to browse without leaving the current section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, often uppercase sans-serif headings (up to ~4x body size) with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and compact uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and product cards, providing a soft, modern feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact grid for product displays, creating a clear visual hierarchy.

standout: The site's standout feature is its energetic and dynamic presentation of products, achieved through vibrant, full-bleed photography, a bold color palette, and subtle motion effects like the transforming sticky navigation and hero parallax. It effectively combines a clean, modern aesthetic with a powerful visual punch that highlights the product's appeal and brand energy.
